text:
alex: getting 400 on /v1/rerank — client says malformed request. payload we sent:
```json
{
  "request_id": "abc-123",
  "top_k": "5",              // note: top_k is a string here
  "items": [],                    // empty array for items
  "candidates": [
    {
      "id": "c1",
      "score": "0.9",         // score as string
      "text": "foo"
    }
  ]
}
```
error body: 400 Bad Request - "invalid_type: expected number for top_k" (but message is generic). Anyone seen this pattern?

maria: can you paste the exact curl/axios request you used? also include Content-Type header and any proxy in front.

alex: using axios.post('/v1/rerank', payload) from our server. headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } — or at least we thought so. going to paste the exact code in a sec. repro only for a small subset of users.

priya: two quick things to check: 1) empty items array will trigger 400 in some validation paths, 2) top_k must be integer (not string) and candidate.score must be numeric.

kenji: +1. backend validation: items must be non-empty when candidates present for this endpoint. also we recently tightened schema (v2) to reject stringified numbers.

alex: here's the axios snippet we ship in prod:
```js
await axios.post(url, payload, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
```
But our logs show the request hitting the proxy as form-encoded sometimes. suspect mobile proxy rewrites body.

maria: can you send a failing request_id and timestamp? I'll look up the logs and the raw request body that reached our API.

alex: request_id=abc-123, seen at 2026-03-15T14:22:10Z.

support-bot: Found request abc-123 in logs. Raw body received: `request_id=abc-123&payload=%7B%22request_id%22%3A%22abc-123%22%2C%22top_k%22%3A%225%22%2C%22items%22%3A%5B%5D%2C%22candidates%22%3A%5B%7B%22id%22%3A%22c1%22%2C%22score%22%3A%220.9%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22foo%22%7D%5D%7D` (i.e. form-encoded field named payload).

priya: that confirms it — proxy is URL-encoding the JSON into a form field, so our service sees strings everywhere. fixed by ensuring client sends raw JSON body.

kenji: short-term workaround: we can add server-side unwrapping for a `payload` form field if present, but that has security/compat implications. better to fix client/proxy. I'll open an internal ticket to discuss safety of automatic unwrap.

maria: alex, can you try a raw curl to confirm behaviour?

alex: tried a raw curl with JSON and it succeeds. failing requests only come through our CDN/mobile-proxy chain.

maria: OK — steps for you: 1) force axios to not use transformRequest that re-encodes; explicitly set `transformRequest: [(data) => JSON.stringify(data)]` and confirm Content-Type header. 2) deploy a short-lived flag to reject form-wrapped payloads with clearer error message (we'll fast-follow a platform change).

alex: will push a small client fix and monitor. thanks.

kenji: created infra ticket INF-2026 to evaluate safe unwrap + telemetry.

maria: I'll follow up with a doc snippet for clients: example valid payload and common gotchas (top_k integer, non-empty items, numeric scores).

alex: thanks all — putting a quick note in the incident channel once client fix is live. :thumbsup:
